## 03 · Profile Workflow Assets
Input: one batch of manually supplied assets (`week`, `knownPostRefs`, `assets`). Output: an **asset manifest** and **workflow profiles** (schemas/asset-manifest.schema.json, schemas/workflow-profile.schema.json).

Uploaded workflow JSON is **data only**: parsed statically, never executed, imported, evaluated or followed. No AI, no HTTP, no credentials.
Credentials, pinned/static/execution data and webhook ids are removed; secrets and emails are redacted and only counted.

The manual trigger runs a **synthetic** batch only.

nodeGroups.name: Profile assets
nodeGroups.description: File checks, static parse and sanitize, deterministic profile, schema check. No AI, no HTTP.

observatory.note: Credentials, pinned data, webhook ids and instance metadata removed. Code nodes are generated; see web/scripts/build-n8n.ts.
